WHERE CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-13' AND DATE '2025-12-25'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3

SELECT 'dup_line_keys' k, count(*) n FROM (SELECT receipt_id, line_no, count(*) c FROM fact_sales_line WHERE receipt_id IN (SELECT web_order_id FROM fact_web_order WHERE dispatch_ts_utc >= TIMESTAMP '2025-12-14' AND dispatch_ts_utc < TIMESTAMP '2025-12-25') GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'dup_sales_line_id', count(*) FROM (SELECT sales_line_id FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-10' AND DATE '2025-12-23' GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'dup_return_id', count(*) FROM (SELECT return_line_id FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'dup_web_order', count(*) FROM (SELECT web_order_id FROM fact_web_order GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'delivered_no_lines', count(*) FROM fact_web_order o WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected') AND dispatch_ts_utc >= TIMESTAMP '2025-12-14' AND dispatch_ts_utc < TIMESTAMP '2025-12-25' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fact_sales_line f WHERE f.receipt_id=o.web_order_id)

calls.statement:
WITH wd AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) dd FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
)
SELECT w.dd,
  sum(f.net_amount) raw_net,
  sum(CASE WHEN s.store_key IS NULL OR p.product_key IS NULL THEN f.net_amount END) unmatched_net,
  sum(CASE WHEN p.category='ZZ Test' THEN f.net_amount END) test_net,
  sum(CASE WHEN s.store_id=999 THEN f.net_amount END) s999_net,
  sum(CASE WHEN s.store_id<>900 THEN f.net_amount END) non900_net,
  sum(CASE WHEN f.staff_purchase_flag THEN f.net_amount END) staff_net,
  count(*) lines, count(DISTINCT f.etl_loaded_at) loads, max(f.etl_loaded_at) lastload
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN wd w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
LEFT JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key LEFT JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE w.dd BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-15' AND DATE '2025-12-23'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, count(*) n, sum(r.refund_net) refund_net, sum(CASE WHEN p.category='ZZ Test' THEN r.refund_net END) test_refund
FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-15' AND DATE '2025-12-23' AND s.store_id IN (900,999)
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2
